svg.title: A reading map for AI software engineering
svg.desc: Start with your next engineering question. The current Non-Deterministic trilogy is: 1, Non-Deterministic Software Engineering, Second Edition, to understand which practices deserve trust; 2, Non-Deterministic Spec-Driven Development: Enterprise Edition, Second Edition, to specify what a change must do; 3, Engineering Software with Agentic AI: Reliable Change with Coding Agents, to practise directing and judging a change. The separately published Packt companion, Loop Engineering for AI Agents, helps build the runtime that controls an agent. Each book stands alone. Arrows identify possible starting points, not prerequisites.
svg.text: A READING MAP FOR AI SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
Choose the book that answers the question in front of you.
How will the agent be controlled?
Each book stands alone. Follow the question you need to answer.
